slots.jd.family-center.about:
Summary
Harvest Table Family Center helps families in Akron build stable, secure homes. We are seeking a Case Manager to work on site with children and caregivers, connecting them to the services and support they need. Candidates must hold a current Case Management Certificate at the time of hire.
slots.jd.family-center.duties:
Duties
- Conduct home visits to check on family progress, safety and household needs.
- Complete intake interviews with new families and gather required documents.
- Carry out needs assessments and update them as family circumstances change.
- Write service plans with clear goals and next steps, and review them with each family.
- Keep case notes current and accurate in the agency database.
- Coordinate with schools, clinics and community partners on referrals and follow-up.
slots.jd.family-center.needs:
Licensure and qualifications
- Required: Case Management Certificate.
- Preferred: Human Services Supervisor Certificate.
- 4 or more years of experience in case management or social services.
- Working knowledge of referral coordination, benefits enrollment and needs assessments.
- Ability to write clear case notes and track client data in Microsoft Access.
- Experience with community outreach to families and local partner agencies.

slots.r1.b2: Conduct intake interviews with families and refer them to housing and food programs that match their needs.
slots.r1.b3: Prepare reports for court hearings that document benefits enrollment progress, raising on-time report submissions by 55 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Complete intake and needs assessments for new clients, then handle referral coordination with partner agencies.
slots.r1.i1: Carries a caseload of families at Maple Court Care, conducting home visits to check on progress and plan next steps.
slots.r1.i2: Prepares reports for hearings at Maple Court Care, drawing on case records and home visit findings.
slots.r2.b1: Logged home visit notes in Microsoft Access, reducing time spent locating case files by 40 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Maintained case records used to draft court reports, keeping files complete and ready for review.
slots.r2.b3: Wrote service plans based on needs assessments, cutting plan turnaround time by 50 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Applied crisis intervention skills while coordinating with schools and clinics to stabilize tenants and their children.

slots.summary.1: Social services case manager with about 4 years of experience carrying a full caseload without close supervision. Skilled in benefits enrollment, referral coordination, court reports, home visits and crisis intervention.
slots.summary.2: Casework professional with about 4 years in housing and family services, managing a full caseload independently. Handles intake interviews, needs assessments, benefits enrollment, referral coordination and court reports from first contact to case closure.
